techmeme.title: Sources detail Anthropic's compute deal spree: 3.5GW+ in expected capacity in 2026, expanding direct hardware procurement to include Nvidia and AMD, and more (New York Times)
Filings: Oracle is selling $10B in common stock and $10B in bonds, as it rushes to line up financing to pay for its data center buildout; ORCL falls 5%+ (Kelly Cloonan/Wall Street Journal)
Sources: Apple is developing a tabletop robot with a 9" screen and a swiveling arm, set for release in 2027 or 2028 for ~$1,000, as John Ternus pushes robotics (Aaron Tilley/The Information)
S-1: Anthropic reports Q3 revenue up 12x YoY to nearly $17B, a net loss of $23.3B, up from $12.1B in Q3 2025, and operating expenses up 292% to $17.5B (Bailey Lipschultz/Bloomberg)
Memo: Alphabet is issuing €6B in euro-denominated debt across seven tranches, attracting €17B+ of demand; the company sold €9B of bonds earlier in 2026 (Reuters)
